name: Trilium Notes
param_style: ? positional via better-sqlite3 (some @named from sql.upsert, :date in one route); ??? expanded to ? lists by getManyRows; table/column names and constant sub-queries spliced with ${...}
schema_source: packages/trilium-core/src/assets/schema.sql (needed CREATE statements only, AGPL); param_list and blob_usage are TEMP tables in the app (sql_init.ts:64, space_usage.ts:498)
data_scale: scale 1: 20k notes (8-ary tree, ~4% deleted in subtree groups), ~22k branches (10% clones, _share subtree), ~38k attributes, ~20k revisions, ~5.8k attachments, ~39k blobs, ~146k entity_changes, 120 options, 500 recent notes
visibility_note: 38.6k stars (TriliumNext fork of zadam/trilium); SQLite is the only storage engine, used by both the desktop app and the sync server
interest_note: Note tree lives in memory, so the SQL is the bulk cache load (json_group_array), recursive subtree CTEs, the entity_changes sync log (paging, sector SUBSTR scans, INSERT OR REPLACE per save), and space-usage analytics with ROW_NUMBER windows and IN/NOT IN over UNIONs.
